name: SpecWeave 2.1 — What changed, and why
summary: Release notes for open-source SpecWeave 2.1 and vskill 1.1.1: portable intent, visible evidence and handoffs across coding tools.
description: Release-notes page for SpecWeave 2.1.0 and vskill 1.1.1, an open-source record of intent, specifications, evidence and handoffs that travels between coding agents. Documents a persistent intent board with drag-and-drop, evidence that survives sessions, separate harness/model/effort/provider records, default hooks reduced to SessionStart and Stop, skill-maintenance cleanups, test-run counts and stated known limits. Install with npm install -g specweave.
contains: persistent intent cards with drag-and-drop and live task progress
default hooks reduced to SessionStart and Stop
16,495 SpecWeave plus 6,167 vskill unit tests passed; 10 baseline docs failures remain
